key.name: accent-hold-shortcut
key.description: The key combination that opens the accent picker. Namespaced because Mutter keybinding names are global to the session.

key.name: trigger
key.description: Deprecated: copied to accent-hold-shortcut on first start of 2.2, then reset. Kept so that reading it cannot abort the shell.

key.name: enabled
key.description: Enable or disable the shortcut. Press-and-hold has its own switch (press-and-hold).

key.name: press-and-hold
key.description: Hold an accentable letter to show its variants.

key.name: hold-ms
key.description: How long in milliseconds a letter must be held to show its variants.

key.name: delay-ms
key.description: Delay in milliseconds before the shortcut picker appears. Does not apply to press-and-hold.

key.name: popup-timeout-ms
key.description: Delay in milliseconds after which the popup closes automatically.

key.name: accents
key.description: Optional JSON overriding the built-in table: an object mapping a letter to a list of variants. Empty or malformed = built-in table.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Show an icon and menu in the GNOME Shell top bar.

key.name: layouts
key.description: xkb layout ids where press-and-hold and the shortcut are active. Empty = all layouts.
